hints.title: Iterating Base Pairs
hints.text: Iterate over all possible values of a and b from 1 to n.

hints.title: Checking Perfect Square Sum
hints.text: compute c_squared = a^2 + b^2 and verify if the integer square root of c_squared squared equals c_squared.

hints.title: Bounding Hypothenuse
hints.text: if c is an integer and c <= n, increment the triple count.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Nested loops iterate over (a, b) and verify square hypothenuse in O(1) integer arithmetic.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: A triple loop iterating over a, b, and c takes O(N^3) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Dual loops with integer square root check run in O(N^2) time with O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should directly check whether a^2 + b^2 is a perfect square <= n^2.
